svg.title: AREA 32
svg.desc: Send one player east to break the boulder and release the gate, opening boxes and a later trap-free route. The timed door triggers Foie traps; ignore them. Use the newly opened inner path and avoid the console. The obvious route near it triggers several Foie traps.
